newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares extend gains, more seen.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares extend gains, more seen.

text.p: Latvian stocks extended their recent modest gains on Monday with the upward trend expected to persist, dealers said.
Total turnover came to 111,000 lats against 93,000 lats and the Rietumu index rose 1.76 percent to 190.59.
"The bourse seems to be steady in its slow upward trend and no big changes are expected in the short-term," Robert Idelsons, Trasta securities department head, told Reuters.
Unibanka was the biggest gainer, adding 10 santimes to 3.40 lats on turnover of 48,400 lats.
Other blue chips also extended their recent gains and Valmiera Glassfibre led the secondary list in trade of 19,400 lats. It rose to 1.58 lats from 1.55 lats.
"Kaija, the Riga Transport Fleet, Valmiera, and Manhgali Shipyard keep gaining as investors seem to be taking a more long-term approach," Idelsons said.

Elsewhere on the official list, the Riga Shipyard was up one santime to 1.38 lats in 10,100 lats of trade and the Riga Transport Fleet had volume of 7,800 lats as it edged up one santime to 1.31 lats.
Other secondary list stocks were sluggish and some 14 of them were not quoted on Monday.
